Following your visit to ITUK for the PMS program introduction, I wanted to share a related request that has come in from their side.

ITUK has contacted us asking for a recommended initial stocking parts list for the new P700 VK05 model.

The commercial urgency behind this request is ITUK's I-Maintain Repair & Maintenance contract program, under which fleet customers pay a fixed monthly fee covering all scheduled servicing, safety inspections, repairs, and MOT preparation — carried out exclusively through the Isuzu dealer network.

A robust initial stocking recommendation from IML would help ITUK protect those commitments from day one.
